issues.description: The problem statement (Aufgabe 03) asks for Zoos in the Gemeinde with gemeindeschluessel `09162999`, but the solution query filters on `gemeindeschluessel = '09162000'`. This discrepancy in the filter value will confuse students about which Gemeindeschluessel to use and will produce different results than the task specifies.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the filter value consistent. Either update the solution query to use gemeindeschluessel = '09162999' to match the problem statement, or (if '09162000' is the intended key) update the problem statement to request gemeindeschluessel '09162000'. Ensure the same key is used in problem, template/examples, and solution so students and automated tests are aligned.
